svg.title: F-08 guide-word scenes
svg.desc: Guide-word scenes for F-08 Select and limit the command sent on. M01 No function: No command passed on and the loss not detected; the vehicle continues on its last command instead of stopping (H-07). M02 Stops functioning: Stops passing commands; same as no function (H-07, rated as M01). M03 Unrequested function: Emergency source selected without a request; the vehicle brakes hard (H-03). M04 Function stuck: A stale command passed on; the vehicle does not slow when the new command does (H-02). M05 Excessive function: Command limits not applied; excessive acceleration reaches the vehicle (H-01). M06 Partial function: Limits applied only in part; bounded by M05 (H-01, rated as M05). M07 Functions early: Remote source selected before the operator's link is valid; the vehicle acts on commands that are not the operator's (H-08). M08 Functions late: Leaves the remote source late; as M11 (H-08, rated as M11). M10 Applies too long: Keeps the remote source after the operator has released it; stale commands as in M11 (H-08, rated as M11). M11 Delayed: Remote commands passed on with latency beyond the bound; they are stale when they act (H-08). M12 Inverse function: Reverse gear passed on where forward is commanded (H-10). M13 Erratic or intermittent: Switches between sources; each switch to emergency acts as M03 (H-03, rated as M03).
svg.text: F-08 Select and limit the command sent on: what each malfunction does
WP-C-03 §6.1, Figure 6-4 (F-08): the 12 safety-related guide words, 7 rated and 5 folded into another. Schematic, not simulation results.
